Text.Text: Hello. I am Dr. Ilsa Marn, the station medic. Sickbay is full, so I am working out of the Recreation room for now. If you want to help, I have plenty of jobs.
Thank you. I will have a culture growing by tonight. Station pay is thin, but you have earned it.
You are back, and those look like Mynock Teeth, roots and all. Do you have all four for me?

Mynocks have been biting the crew. They came in on a salvage hull and now they nest on the Maintenance Level, and their bites turn septic within a day. I need to find out what they carry. Please kill Mynocks on the Maintenance Level, collect four Mynock Teeth from them and bring the teeth back to me here in the Recreation room.
Good. Bring me four Mynock Teeth. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220.
They are on the Maintenance Level, one deck below us. The way down is next to Foreman Dorn Ketch, by the Fabrication Terminals. The Mynocks gather wherever there is cable to chew.
I still need four Mynock Teeth. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
These are clean cuts and they will cure well. You have saved the refinery crew some skin. Here is your pay.
You are back, and I can see wings in your pack. Did you bring me all three Mynock Wings?

Yes, I can use their wings. The membrane makes a better burn dressing than the synthskin Czerka ships us, and the refinery sends me burns every shift. Please kill Mynocks on the Maintenance Level, collect three Mynock Wings from them and bring the wings back to me here in the Recreation room.
Good. Bring me three Mynock Wings. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220.
I still need three Mynock Wings. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
This is fresh enough, and I will carry it to the galley myself. The cooks send their thanks. Here is your pay.
You are back from the Maintenance Level. Did you bring all five pieces of Mynock Meat for the galley?

No, they are not. The protein ration is two shipments late. I have cleared Mynock meat as safe to eat when it is cooked through, and the galley keeps asking me for it. Please kill Mynocks on the Maintenance Level, collect five pieces of Mynock Meat and bring them back to me here in the Recreation room.
Good. Bring me five pieces of Mynock Meat. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220.
I still need five pieces of Mynock Meat. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level of CZ-220. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
They are only scraps, but they are soft, and that is what I need. That is a month of splints. Thank you.
You are back, and I see leather scraps. Did you bring me all six pieces of Ruined Leather?

Yes, I am out of padding. I splint a wrist every week and I have nothing soft to wrap the splints in. Ruined Leather will do the job. The Mynocks on the Maintenance Level drop it, and the supply caches around the station hold it too. Please collect six pieces of Ruined Leather and bring them back to me here.
Good. Bring me six pieces of Ruined Leather. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level or the supply caches.
I still need six pieces of Ruined Leather. You can get them from the Mynocks on the Maintenance Level or the supply caches. Bring them to me here when you have them all.
Thank you. This is hazard pay from the sickbay budget, and it is worth every credit to me.
You are back, and it has been a quiet shift with nobody bleeding. Did you kill all eight Mynocks?

You can cut down on what bites them. Almost every patient I treat was bitten by a Mynock on the Maintenance Level. I need you to go down to the Maintenance Level and kill eight Mynocks. Come back to me here in the Recreation room when it is done and I will pay you from the sickbay budget.
Good. Kill eight Mynocks on the Maintenance Level, then come back to me here in the Recreation room. Mind your fingers.
You still need to kill eight Mynocks on the Maintenance Level. Come back to me here in the Recreation room when it is done.
So I am at the top of a list of things that have not arrived. Thank you for asking, at least. Here is your pay.
You are back from Supplies. What did Quartermaster Raye say about my medical supplies?

Yes, I do. I filed a supply manifest two weeks ago and I have heard nothing since. I need you to go to Quartermaster Tobin Raye in Supplies, on this deck, and ask him where my medical supplies are. Then come back to me here in the Recreation room and tell me what he said.
Good. Ask Quartermaster Tobin Raye in Supplies where my medical supplies are, then come back to me here in the Recreation room with his answer.
You still need to ask Quartermaster Tobin Raye in Supplies where my medical supplies are. Come back to me here in the Recreation room once you have his answer.
Thank you. Please go back to Quartermaster Raye in Supplies and use those exact words.
He wants a count of my splints? Tell him the count is none. I have no splints at all. I am using deck plating and a great deal of optimism.
Take care of yourself, Doctor.
What else can I do to help sickbay?
Yes, that is all four of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you four Mynock Teeth.
Not right now, Doctor.
Where do I find the Mynocks?
What has been biting people on this station?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Mynock Teeth you asked for.
Yes, that is all three of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you three Mynock Wings.
Not right now, Doctor.
Can you use anything from the Mynocks as medicine?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Mynock Wings you asked for.
Yes, that is all five of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you five pieces of Mynock Meat.
Not right now, Doctor.
Is the crew getting enough to eat?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the pieces of Mynock Meat you asked for.
Yes, that is all six of them.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will bring you six pieces of Ruined Leather.
Not right now, Doctor.
Is sickbay short of any other supplies?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the pieces of Ruined Leather you asked for.
Yes, all eight Mynocks are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill eight Mynocks on the Maintenance Level.
Not right now, Doctor.
Can I help you cut down on patients?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Mynocks.
They are on the late shipment, but sickbay is top of his list.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will ask Quartermaster Raye about your supplies.
Not right now, Doctor.
Do you have an errand that does not involve Mynocks?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you wanted me to ask the quartermaster.
You have none. I will tell him that.
Not right now.
Quartermaster Raye wants to know how many splints you have.
